content.help:
Off - Modded, suppresses passive limb regeneration for the player.
On - Vanilla, allows passive limb regeneration for the player.

Off - Modded, ordinary Stimpaks only heal player HP.
On - Vanilla, ordinary Stimpaks heal player HP and limb HP.

Off - Records no PLH diagnostics.
Errors - Records a compact startup/capability summary plus failures and abnormal states.
Verbose - Records the Errors-level summary plus normal lifecycle/state diagnostics and every MCM setting change.

Off - Disables performance logging.
On - Enables performance logging.
